description: USA Historic Sites is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. Retirement Notice: This item is in mature support as of June 2026 and will be retired in December 2028. Please use this source dataset and follow the steps in the From Vector to Raster blog as a replacement for this service. Esri recommends updating your maps and apps. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are esri_environment, retiring-2028-12. The bounding box given is -159.6659,13.3771,145.7317,61.8009. The hub shows 2026-03-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
